show: The Bible in a Year (with Fr. Mike Schmitz)

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen (Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst podtrac.com) - zu wenig fuer ein Urteil, aber nicht nichts; Texte aus dem Begleittext des Podcasters, kein Transkript - ohne Zeitachse sind Clips und Sprungmarken unmoeglich

einzeiler: An introduction to the Gospel of Matthew and Proverbs 18.
kurzfassung: Fr. Mike introduces the Gospel of Matthew, covering the genealogy, nativity, and early ministry of Jesus. The discussion explores how Jesus reconstitutes the kingdom and invites participation. Today's episode also includes readings from Proverbs 18.
stichpunkte: Introduction to the Gospel of Matthew
The first days of Jesus's ministry
The invitation to join the kingdom
beschreibung:
Fr. Mike introduces us to the Gospel of Matthew, including his genealogy, nativity, and the first days of his ministry. He pulls it all together to show that not only is Jesus reconstituting the kingdom in his ministry, but he's inviting us to join him in this kingdom. Today’s readings are Matthew 1-4, and Proverbs 18:17-20.

For the complete reading plan, visit ascensionpress.com/bibleinayear.

Please note: The Bible contains adult themes that may not be suitable for children - parental discretion is advised.
